features.name: time_of_day_normalized
features.description: Departure time normalized to [0,1] range across the full day (0-1439 minutes), providing a smooth continuous representation of time position in the day
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear SVM can use this smooth continuous feature to find optimal time-based decision boundaries for delay prediction

features.name: late_day_departure_score
features.description: Score emphasizing afternoon and evening departures (after 720 minutes / noon) which tend to accumulate delays throughout the day
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the known pattern that later flights accumulate delays; smooth score useful for linear margin separation

features.name: flight_length_normalized
features.description: Flight duration normalized by log transformation and scaled to [0,1] using training set min/max (log1p(25)=3.258, log1p(560)=6.330)
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized flight length reduces skewness and provides smooth input for linear SVM margin optimization

features.name: time_length_interaction
features.description: Interaction between normalized departure time and normalized flight length, capturing combined effect of late departures on long flights
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an approximate bilinear feature that linear SVM can use to capture interaction effects between time and flight duration

features.name: peak_hour_indicator
features.description: Soft indicator for peak travel hours (6am-9am: 360-540 min, and 4pm-8pm: 960-1200 min) using smooth transitions
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures congestion during peak hours which correlates with delays; smooth score better than hard binary for SVM

features.name: weekend_flight_score
features.description: Binary indicator for weekend flights (Saturday=6, Sunday=7) which have different delay patterns than weekdays
features.expected_model_benefit: Weekend vs weekday distinction provides a useful binary feature for linear SVM to separate delay patterns

features.name: midweek_congestion_score
features.description: Score for midweek days (Wednesday=3, Thursday=4, Friday=5) which are typically busiest travel days with higher delay risk
features.expected_model_benefit: Midweek congestion pattern provides discriminative signal for linear SVM delay prediction

features.name: long_haul_indicator
features.description: Soft indicator for long-haul flights (above mean length of 131 minutes), normalized by standard deviation (70 minutes)
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardized flight length deviation from mean provides a centered feature useful for SVM margin optimization

features.name: time_deviation_from_mean
features.description: Standardized departure time deviation from training mean (803.26 minutes) scaled by standard deviation (277.21 minutes)
features.expected_model_benefit: Zero-centered time feature improves SVM convergence and allows linear separation around the mean departure time

features.name: airline_delay_propensity
features.description: Semantic assessment of airline's historical delay propensity based on carrier reputation and operational characteristics. WN (Southwest) and regional carriers (OO, MQ, XE, EV) scored higher due to known operational challenges; major network carriers (DL, AA, UA) scored moderate; low-cost efficient carriers scored lower.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes domain knowledge about carrier reliability into a continuous score that linear SVM can use as a weighted feature

features.name: hub_airport_congestion_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of departure airport congestion level based on hub status and known congestion. Major hubs (ATL, ORD, DFW, LAX, JFK) scored high (0.7-0.9); secondary hubs (DEN, IAH, PHX, DTW) scored medium (0.4-0.6); smaller airports scored low (0.1-0.3).
features.expected_model_benefit: Airport congestion is a key delay driver; this continuous score provides smooth signal for linear SVM boundary optimization

features.name: route_complexity_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of route operational complexity combining origin-destination pair characteristics. Cross-country routes, routes through weather-prone regions, and routes between major congested hubs scored higher (0.6-0.9); short regional hops scored lower (0.1-0.4).
features.expected_model_benefit: Route complexity captures geographic and operational factors affecting delays that complement time-based features for linear SVM
